map.Hofstetter 经验公式按年龄估算调节幅度区间，近点距离 = 100 /: The Hofstetter empirical formula estimates the amplitude of accommodation range by age, and the near point distance = 100 / amplitude (cm); it is used to assess presbyopia and accommodative insufficiency.
map.→ 打开调节幅度与年龄计算器工具: -> Open the Amplitude of Accommodation and Age Calculator tool
map.基于 Hofstetter 经验公式输入年龄计算最小/平均/最大调节幅度与近点距: Based on the Hofstetter empirical formula, enter an age to compute the minimum / average / maximum amplitude of accommodation and the near point distance to assess accommodative function, for presbyopia and visual fatigue analysis.
map.按年龄对照 Hofstetter 公式看是否早衰。: Compare the age against the Hofstetter formula to see whether presbyopia is appearing early.
map.推近视标到模糊（近点），记录距离；A=1/近点(m)−1/远点(m)，远点无穷远: Move the near target until it blurs (near point) and record the distance; A=1/near point(m)−1/far point(m), and when the far point is at infinity it is 1/near point.
map.最小 A = 15 − 0.25×年龄；平均 A = 18.5 − 0.30×年: Minimum A = 15 − 0.25×age; average A = 18.5 − 0.30×age; maximum A = 25 − 0.40×age (Hofstetter)
map.由远点、近点算调节幅度（单位 D）。: Compute the amplitude of accommodation (in dioptres) from the far point and near point.
map.老花即调节幅度随龄下降，附加=习惯阅读距离需求−剩余幅度，通常近用 40cm 需: Presbyopia is the decline of the amplitude of accommodation with age, and the add equals the demand of the habitual reading distance minus the remaining amplitude; a 40 cm near distance usually needs 2.5 D.

map.：30 岁 Hofstetter 均值≈8.5D、最小≈4.5D；实测 8D 正: : at age 30 the Hofstetter mean is ≈8.5 D and the minimum ≈4.5 D; a measured 8 D is normal. At age 50 the mean is ≈2.5 D, and below that a presbyopic add is needed.
map.：远点 50cm(2D)、近点 10cm(10D) → 调节幅度 A=1/近点−: : far point 50 cm (2 D), near point 10 cm (10 D) → amplitude A = 1/near point − 1/far point = 10−2 = 8.00 D.
